Package com.egradx.redis

Class EgradxRedisRoleAuthoritiesRelay

java.lang.Object
com.egradx.redis.EgradxRedisRoleAuthoritiesRelay
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.springframework.data.redis.connection.MessageListener
public class EgradxRedisRoleAuthoritiesRelay extends Object implements org.springframework.data.redis.connection.MessageListener
Tells every instance when a role's authorities change, so each evicts it from its own egradx-role-authorities cache at once — not when the entry expires (60 s by default). egradx-auth evicts the changing instance's entry itself; this relays the change to the rest, over <prefix>auth:role-authorities-changed (contracts/redis).

Fails open: an announcement that cannot be sent leaves the other instances to their cache's expiry.
